outline.keyPoint: Jack was a home nurse. One morning his manager sent him to a new patient. An extraordinary old woman, he called her.
Jack asked if it was really okay. Of course it's okay, said the manager. You will get paid a lot. Go in.
The granny welcomed him with a cup of chai. Sit on the sofa and wait, she said. I have to go to my room.
Hours passed. On the shelf, Jack found a photo. The granny, standing next to another home nurse.
That one left early, she said. Jack was not so sure about that.
She showed him the guest room. There was one rule. Do not be awake after midnight. Or else.
The first nights, Jack could not sleep. Just homesick, he told himself. Just homesick.
But every day, the granny got meaner. She snapped at him. She pinched him. She hit him.
One night he was still awake after midnight. And then he heard it. Knocking. Slow. Odd. Knocking.
He fell asleep right there. In the morning he told himself it was just a bad dream. Just a nightmare.
The next night, she came into his room. And she told him a story. Not about herself, she said. About Raphael Amma.
Raphael Amma had a husband, Raphael Appa, and seven children. And every single one of them ignored her.
She did not divorce him. She prayed. To the devil. I want to eat them all, she said. But the three youngest later. When they are older.
And she ate them. One by one. The devil moved in. Until only the three youngest were left.
Years later, she ate two more. But the last child she loved. She let him run away from the house. The devil, she said, would find him anyway.
Jack was terrified. That same night, when the granny went out, he ran.
He ran through the dark, deep into the woods. And he ended up in front of a small hut.
Inside: blood on the floor. And a book, full of odd letters. The first words read: Dear devil.
Jack knew there was no way out of this house. He sat down on the floor. And he cried.
Behind him, the door opened. Raphael Amma. Possessed. With an axe in her hand.
Because the devil had kept his promise. Jack was the missing son. The last child. The one she let run away.
The axe fell. And the moment Jack was gone, the devil had nothing left to keep. Raphael Amma turned to dust.
Would you have gone in? Tell me in the comments. And subscribe for the next story.
